donate.t003: The Lonah Maiko Foundation relies on the generosity of supporters who believe in creating lasting change for children, families, and underserved communities in Kenya. Every contribution directly strengthens our work in Education, Health, and WASH, enabling us to provide school support, promote healthy living, and expand access to clean water and sanitation. Your donation helps us deliver practical, community-driven solutions that restore dignity, offer opportunity, and improve daily life for those who need it most.
donate.t004: We are committed to transparency, accountability, and long-term impact. By giving to LMF, you become part of a compassionate mission dedicated to empowering communities and building a brighter, more resilient future. Whether you choose to support a student, strengthen our WASH projects, or contribute to our broader community programs, your partnership makes a real and immediate difference.
donate.t007: Giving by card, as an organisation, or from outside Kenya? Email us and we'll send the right payment details.
donate.t010: At The Lonah Maiko Foundation, every cent donated by partner schools and individual student sponsors goes directly to Africa to support the exact person or community for whom it was intended. We ensure that 100% of donor contributions reach the ground—funding education support, WASH initiatives, and community programs without any deductions. Your giving directly transforms lives, strengthens families, and uplifts vulnerable learners and communities with full transparency and accountability.

index.t001: Transforming Lives Through Education, Health, and Sustainable Development
index.t003: The Lonah Maiko Foundation is dedicated to creating lasting change in communities through integrated development programs across education, health, and water, sanitation, and hygiene (WASH).
index.t005: Our Education Programs focus on giving every learner an equal chance to succeed by removing the barriers that hold children back. Through direct support to schools, mentorship initiatives, learning materials, and community engagement, we work to create nurturing environments where students can thrive academically and socially. By partnering with teachers, parents, and local leaders, we ensure that learners not only access education but also receive the guidance, encouragement, and resources they need to unlock their full potential. Our goal is to build confident, empowered students who can shape a brighter future for themselves and their communities.
index.t007: Community health initiatives in rural and hard-to-reach areas are designed to address gaps caused by distance, limited infrastructure, health-worker shortages, and poverty. These initiatives focus on bringing healthcare closer to communities, improving disease prevention, and empowering local populations to take charge of their own health. This involves a wide range of activities such as health education, mobile clinics, CHW training, nutrition programs, WASH improvements, and disease-specific interventions. These programs address challenges like limited access to healthcare, high disease burden, and poverty-driven health disparities.
index.t009: Our WASH Programs strengthen community health and dignity by improving access to clean water, sanitation, and proper hygiene practices. We collaborate with communities, institutions, and health facilities to implement sustainable solutions such as safe water systems, sanitation facilities, and hygiene awareness campaigns. These efforts help reduce disease, promote healthier living, and create safer learning and home environments. Through continuous education, community involvement, and long-term support, we work to ensure that families and children enjoy the fundamental right to clean water and a hygienic environment, leading to healthier and stronger communities.
index.t011: Our Student Sponsorship Program is designed to support vulnerable learners who face financial and social barriers that threaten their education. By providing school fees, uniforms, learning materials, and mentorship, we help students remain in school and stay focused on their academic goals. Each sponsorship is a lifeline that restores hope, stability, and opportunity for children who would otherwise be left behind. Through close collaboration with schools, families, and community leaders, we ensure that every sponsored learner receives holistic support—empowering them to pursue their dreams and build a stronger future for themselves and their communities.
index.t013: Our Community Empowerment Program strengthens families and local groups by equipping them with the knowledge, tools, and opportunities they need to improve their own livelihoods. Through training, capacity building, awareness campaigns, and collaborative projects, we help communities develop practical solutions to the challenges they face in education, health, and daily living. By encouraging participation, leadership, and shared responsibility, we create an environment where people can take charge of their growth and well-being. This approach ensures long-lasting impact, builds resilience, and fosters a united community committed to creating a better future for all.
index.t015: Our Strategic Partnerships Program focuses on building strong, meaningful collaborations that expand our impact and strengthen community development. By working closely with schools, health facilities, government agencies, NGOs, and private sector partners, we align shared goals and pool resources to address critical needs in Education, Health, and WASH. These partnerships allow us to implement larger, more sustainable initiatives that reach more families and deliver long-term results. Through transparency, shared responsibility, and mutual commitment, we create powerful alliances that drive positive change, enhance service delivery, and support the growth of resilient, empowered communities.
index.t018: To improve the quality of life for disadvantaged communities in Africa through integrated development programs that prioritize education, health, and environmental sustainability.
index.t020: A future where every child has access to quality education, every community has access to healthcare and clean water, and sustainable development creates opportunity for all.

index.t047: The Lonah Maiko Foundation (LMF) is a community-centered organisation dedicated to improving the quality of life for children, families, and underserved communities in Kenya. Founded on the belief that every person deserves dignity, opportunity, and a healthy environment, LMF works to bridge gaps in Education, Health, and WASH (Water, Sanitation & Hygiene). We collaborate closely with schools, health facilities, local leaders, and partners to bring practical, sustainable solutions that directly transform lives. From supporting learners, promoting healthy communities, to advancing clean water and sanitation, our approach is rooted in compassion, transparency, and long-term impact. Guided by strong values and a passion for service, LMF continues to provide hope, empower communities, and create pathways for a brighter, more resilient future.

news.t002: Latest project updates and success stories from our communities
news.t004: Stay updated with our latest project developments, impact stories, and community initiatives.
news.t006: Six children. One family reunited. A new beginning.
news.t007: The Lonah Maiko Foundation (LMF) intervened to support six children—four boys and two girls—who had been left without care after their family faced very difficult circumstances.
news.t008: The children had been moving from door to door, seeking food and shelter. Through LMF's intervention, all six were reunited with their grandfather, who had never known they existed.
news.t009: All six children are now safe and cared for, and the girls are protected from Female Genital Mutilation (FGM).
news.t010: For these six children, the change is already visible. They now have a home, a family who knows them, and adults who are looking out for them. With new uniforms, folders and exercise books, they are ready to take their place in the classroom alongside other children their age.
news.t011: Our work continues. The children need support with education, food, clothing and daily upkeep. We invite well-wishers, donors and partners to join us in giving them a brighter future.
news.t013: “Sometimes changing a child's world doesn't begin with millions of money. It begins with showing up, extending a hand, and reminding them that their dreams matter. Every child deserves a chance.” ❤️
news.t015: Faith's Journey: From Poverty to Promise
news.t016: Meet Faith, a bright young girl who was on the brink of child labor in tea plantations. Thanks to a Lonah Maiko Foundation scholarship, Faith now attends school daily, receives new uniforms, stationery, and even daily lunch through our Scholarship Plus program. Her story exemplifies how education transforms lives.
news.t018: Empowering Children with Disabilities Through Education
news.t019: The Lonah Maiko Foundation proudly supports children with disabilities, recognizing their full potential regardless of challenges. Our inclusive education programs build self-confidence and empowerment, enabling these remarkable children to achieve their dreams and contribute to their communities.
news.t021: Investing in Girls' Education: Breaking the Poverty Cycle
news.t022: Following UN recommendations, our foundation prioritizes girls' education in sub-Saharan Africa. By supporting female students, we're not just educating individuals—we're creating empowered women who will lead their communities out of poverty and disease. Every scholarship makes a difference.
news.t024: Education vs. Exploitation: Saving Futures from Child Labor
news.t025: Many children in our program areas face the harsh choice between education and child labor in tea plantations, quarries, or worse. Our scholarships provide the alternative they deserve—quality education, uniforms, books, and hope for a brighter future free from exploitation.
news.t027: Scholarship Program Updates: Rising to Meet Needs
news.t028: Due to rising living costs in Kenya, we've updated our scholarship fees for the first time in 5 years. Basic scholarships are now $390/year, while Scholarship Plus (including daily school lunch) is $660/year. These funds ensure comprehensive support for our students' education journey.
news.t030: Building Lifelong Connections: Sponsors Meet Their Students
news.t031: Our sponsors receive detailed student profiles, school reports, and are encouraged to write letters fostering meaningful relationships. These connections create a global community united in the fight against poverty through education. Your support changes lives—and creates lasting bonds.
news.t033: Get regular updates on our latest initiatives and impact stories.

wash.t001: Clean Water, Sanitation & Hygiene for All
wash.t003: Water, sanitation, and hygiene (WASH) are fundamental human rights. We work to ensure all communities have access to clean water and proper sanitation.
wash.t005: Building boreholes, wells, and water harvesting systems to provide reliable access to clean drinking water.
wash.t007: Constructing and maintaining proper toilets and washing facilities in schools and communities.
wash.t009: Training communities on handwashing, menstrual hygiene, food safety, and personal health practices.
wash.t011: Implementing comprehensive WASH initiatives in schools to improve student health and attendance.
wash.t013: Establishing maintenance systems and training local teams to ensure long-term functionality of water systems.
wash.t015: Protecting water sources and promoting environmental conservation for sustainable WASH services.
wash.t017: Access to clean water and sanitation is a fundamental human right and critical for development. The lack of WASH services leads to preventable diseases, school absenteeism, and economic loss.
wash.t018: Our WASH programs have reached thousands of people, providing clean water, proper sanitation, and hygiene education. These interventions save lives, improve health, increase school attendance, especially for girls, and boost economic productivity.
wash.t021: Our WASH programs have directly improved water and sanitation access for over 10,000 people in rural communities.
wash.t023: Communities with WASH programs experience a 50% reduction in water-borne illnesses like cholera and diarrhea.
wash.t025: Girls' school attendance increased by 30% in schools with proper WASH facilities, particularly menstrual hygiene facilities.
